steps.what: Verify required materials or supplies, specifications and permitted recipients
Enter verified materials and supplies into a draft order
Check quantities, access implications and terms before placing the supply order

tasks.design: Configure {PROCUREMENT} templates to populate draft orders from a supervisor-verified request. Keep stock checks, sizing, key or badge permissions and final order placement human; an order never grants access or authorises key duplication by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated entry follows separate checks of supply need and security authorisation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native requisition templates can copy verified item fields without making access decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Sensitive key or badge specifications and changes in permitted recipients.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when an apparently routine supply request has security consequences.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated order entry with unchanged supply and security decision rights.

reach.task: Report supply needs and missing controlled items
reach.learn: Distinguish ordinary replenishment from a security incident

evidence.claim: Populating supply orders from verified requests is a plausible native procurement configuration; the digest contains no measured security supply-ordering case.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor supply request checking, entry and order placement; excludes supplier production, receiving and separate credential issuance or access-right changes.

Supervisor produces item/specification reference, quantity/unit, size where applicable, approved recipient and key/badge authority reference where required, supplier, price and delivery details in s1. Its full 50 hours include stock checks, capture and clarification.

Test native templates before code. Missing controlled-item authority or changed specifications stops draft generation and requires manual checking; ordinary uniform fields cannot stand in for security authorisation.
Five additional focal hours cover controlled-item checks, request-template upkeep and order exceptions; two purchasing-team hours cover catalogue mappings.
unknowns: Who authorises controlled keys and badges
Required treatment of sensitive order details
research_questions: Does draft population save time after full capture and controlled-item checks?

already_counted.description: Stock, specification, recipient and authority verification with capture

incremental.description: Controlled-item audits, template upkeep and order exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact item specifications, sizes, quantities, permitted recipient and authority references, supplier, prices and delivery details; changes require renewed approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=50+0+25=75, gross=25, focal upkeep=5, net=20. High requires repeat supply lines and complete verified requests that currently need re-entry; low retains manual entry for unusual or sensitive items plus upkeep. Stock, sizing, security and commercial checks retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Routine order entry may shrink; verification of need, controlled-item authority and final placement remain human.
reach: Agree controlled-item request and escalation responsibilities with security guards
role.ambitious_version: A security supervisor with traceable supply orders and less repeated entry who retains control of security-sensitive purchasing.
